records.title: Activation means first item done
records.text: Project → concise strategy and initiatives → steering → meaningful item done under its actual completion obligations.

records.title: One teaching authority
records.text: Public product source feeds installed and web copies. Project policies and private operating choices retain their own owners.

records.title: Complete and extremely concise
records.text: Recipe first. Every teaching file and response: hard 350 lines. Character and smaller line targets prompt review, not arbitrary compression.

records.title: One existing context chain
records.text: No unconditional native global publisher or second project context block. Global orientation and yoke-global lead to a new project-bound session.

records.title: Keep candidate, desired and live apart
records.text: Source presence is not live delivery. A gap record is not completed teaching. Verify the receiving release and context.

records.title: Adopt optional capabilities when useful
records.text: Environments, preview, test machines, QA plans, migrations, test registration, Doctor and architecture are not a universal onboarding checklist. Existing rules and selected work still govern.

records.title: Prototype and upkeep come first
records.text: FIRST-USER 0 is linked Issues YOK-3914 and PLAT-220. Check the master into Yoke internal docs, then install and verify both projects’ upkeep rules during blocking post-deploy item QA. Yoke items edit their own source; Platform items file linked Yoke updates. Both Issues precede all remaining work under either plan.

records.title: QA follows its subject and target
records.text: Local tests/review can satisfy suitable item QA. Preview or post-deploy environments are needed only by QA that requires them. Merge-only preserves required reviews and approvals.

records.title: Facts belong to the right scope
records.text: Shared project/universe choices persist; readiness is checked on each machine. Configured, deferred, not needed and unknown remain distinct.

records.title: TUI issue sync silently off
records.text: Agent setup may explain and offer relevant opt-in. Keep the default off and verify deliberate enable paths. Broader dedup remains deferred; entry 2 stays as written.
